eligible_groups: Residents/Workers/Students in Tomioka City (requires 'Ai-Taku Card' after first ride)

reservation_methods.note: Reservations accepted from 5 days prior up to 20 minutes before boarding.
Recommended for simple operations. Notifications are sent directly to the talk room.
Mandatory for wheelchair users. Reservations accepted from 5 days prior up to 20 minutes before boarding.

reservation_window: From 5 days in advance until 20 minutes before the scheduled ride
important_notes: Wheelchair users must book by phone. Effective April 2025, wheelchair bookings must be made at least 2 days in advance.
Users eligible for the 100 yen fare must present ID on their first ride to receive an 'Ai-Taku Card'.
Large luggage that occupies an extra seat is not permitted.
Pets are allowed only in carry bags small enough to fit on your lap.
The taxi will not wait if you are not at the stop at the reserved time.
